scope: Nine-district pilot; existing identities only; no assessment/proficiency/EL-exit/SEDA collection.
review_rules: Retain the frozen v1 and every original canonical evidence row.
Operation review and source policy years remain separate. Earliest reviewed reference bounds do not assert policy start dates.
Only exact reviewed school/district/language/model correspondences receive programme-level facts.
Keep source-labelled ratios separate from grade-specific named-language schedules and core-only ratios.
Respect native-language literacy exceptions, programme/language differences and future changes.
Apply the user-authorized same-programme inference only with named donor/recipient scope and an inference method.
No roster omission becomes a closure, no generic Chinese becomes Mandarin without programme evidence, and no English partner is supplied without explicit linked-source support.
